landing.subtitleGaming: Shots and stories from the worlds of video games

hero.title: rawb.start
hero.subtitle:
The game gives you a camera. I look for another one.
I capture scenes from the angle the game doesn't offer you, choose every camera move and framing, then turn them into a visual story.

trailers.title: Trailers
trailers.description: Cinematic trailers for **major games**, cut for _Instagram_, TikTok and YouTube.

ambient-overviews.title: Environment overviews
ambient-overviews.description: Environmental showcases that let the **world** of each game speak for itself.

camas-game-slice.title: A Slice of indies
camas-game-slice.description: Cama's Game Slice entrusted me with the video for their **indie games**: a series of **trailers**, a **showreel** bringing all the titles together, and the **portfolio**'s videos, from the hero to the project card previews.

hero.title: Roberto De Simone
hero.subtitle: Polished videos that tell a brand's story: clean pacing, a clear message and a look people recognize.

gaming-dogs.description: Gaming Dogs is the gaming channel by **Slim Dogs**, combining **video games** and **storytelling** through ironic and highly polished formats.

stories.title: Food Stories
stories.description: Prattquello is an Italian content creator who creates digital content focused on **food** and **entertainment**. His approach is summed up by the phrase **_eating is not just chewing_**, which lies at the heart of his main format, where food becomes a visual story: **_Food Stories_**. As an **editor**, I worked on the evolution of the format, introducing **improvements** to the structure of the videos and the way the content is presented. A balancing act between aesthetics and storytelling, making each story work in the most **direct** way possible.

mulino.title: Mulino
mulino.description: **_Il Mulino_** is a fast-paced format where **food** and **jokes** come together. In the **editing**, I focused on pushing the **timing** of the jokes and keeping the video's **energy** high, building a fast and **engaging** flow, especially in the vertical format.

travel.title: Travel
travel.description: Format between **travel** and **food** that tells stories of traditions, places, and **people** through food. In the **editing**, I worked to give continuity to the **storytelling**, balancing contextual shots, preparation, and **human** interaction. The goal is to capture not only what is being eaten, but also the environment and the **stories** surrounding it.

alessandro-benetton.description: Video talks created for Alessandro Benetton, entrepreneur and manager, focusing on **experiences** and reflections on the **business world**. In the **editing**, I worked to structure the content in a clear and **smooth** way, refining the **pacing** and organization of the speech to improve the viewing experience.

san-carlo.description: San Carlo Taste Hunter is a **branded** project focused on **food** storytelling, featuring several content creators in the field. As an **editor**, I worked on the **re-editing** of existing videos, implementing the **changes requested** by the client and ensuring a **consistent** and effective result.

youtube.title: YouTube
youtube.description: I worked on the main formats of Slim Dogs, including **_How the f**k did they do it_**, **_Production disasters_**, **_The science of…_**, and **_Professional reacts_**, content built around analysis, storytelling, and entertainment. I handled the **editing** and **pre-editing**, collaborating with writers on the selection of **content** and the construction of the **narrative structure**.

social.title: Social
social.description: I worked on the most recognizable social formats of **Slim Dogs** and **Cane Secco** for **Instagram** and **TikTok**, contributing to the **editing** of content designed for a fast-paced and immediate language. In addition to editing, I also handled the **color correction** of some videos, focusing on pacing, **visual impact**, and readability in fast-paced formats.

prime-video.description: Projects created in collaboration with **Amazon Prime Video** and **Slim Dogs**, featuring writers, actors, and other figures connected to the platform's series. I handled the **editing** of videos for **YouTube** and **social** content (reels and stories) for the launch of **The Traitors Italia**.

nuvola-yoga.description: Content for the Nuvola Yoga YouTube channel, focused on **yoga** practice and **well-being**. I handled the **editing** with a calm and **relaxed pace**, paying particular attention to the **fluidity** of the instructors' movements.

backstage-hiver.description: **Behind the scenes** of the short film **_Hiver_**, created as the final project for the **Videomaker** course at **ITS Rossellini**. I worked both as a **camera operator** and **editor**, capturing key moments to **document** the set and conducting **interviews** with actors and crew members.

masterclass-festa-cinema-roma.description: Thanks to **ITS Rossellini**, I had the opportunity to work at the prestigious **Festa del Cinema di Roma** as a **camera operator** and **editor** during masterclasses with renowned names in cinema: **Viggo Mortensen**, **Chiara Mastroianni**, the **D'Innocenzo brothers**, **Dennis Lehane**, and **Saverio Costanzo**. An extraordinary experience that allowed me to actively take part in one of the most important events in the **international film scene**.

color-grading.description: **Color Grading** projects created independently to explore the **storytelling potential of color** and make the most of the **aesthetic** of each clip.

about.title: About
about.introGaming: I'm a <hl>video editor</hl> and gaming is my thing: I cut highlights, trailers and Instagram content with one goal, keeping viewers watching from the first second. I work on <hl>rhythm</hl>, sound and the moments that make the difference, because a good clip doesn't just show the game: it tells it.
about.introBrand: I'm a <hl>video editor</hl> working with brands and creators to turn ideas and raw footage into clear, polished videos. I focus on <hl>social</hl> content and brand videos, with attention to visual consistency, pacing and message. My goal is for every video to sound like the brand behind it.

slim-dogs.description: Long-form and short-form editing for YouTube and social, focused on pacing and retention. For creators and brands like Gaming Dogs, Amazon Prime Video and San Carlo.

festa-del-cinema.description: Shot and edited masterclasses with Viggo Mortensen and Dennis Lehane, among others. Red carpet photography.

freelance.description: Reels, trailers and showreels for indie games for Cama's Game Slice. Event coverage for Rome Future Week and Roma3x3.
